text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly taking profits in Stock D, C and E did not prevent my account value from falling; I should decide position sizes and exits using the portfolio outlook, not the pleasure of realizing a gain.","I held Stock C until the loss was extreme before selling. I should set and review risk limits earlier rather than let reluctance to realize a loss dictate my decisions.","I bought Stock B and D again at higher prices after selling them, and added to B at a much higher price later. Before each trade, I should reassess its expected return and risk instead of reacting to past prices or treating each stock as a separate account."]}
